question: Should gitcrawl adopt this schema-v10 source-revision ordering contract for existing v0.7.1 archives and concurrent sync persistence?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven, but it establishes a long-term persisted-data and conflict-resolution contract that automated tests cannot authorize on the maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Adopt After Cleanup
options.body: Remove the changelog entry and merge after explicit store/sync owner confirmation of the migration and ordering semantics.

options.title: Keep Draft for Redesign
options.body: Pause merge if maintainers want a narrower migration surface or different equal-observation and deletion semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the changelog entry and merge after explicit store/sync owner confirmation of the migration and ordering semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The v0.7.1 baseline introduced the central store and synchronization contract now being migrated and reordered.
